text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Tosen Jordan was at the beach with her gal 
pals. —All to look away from "what comes 
next." She even skipped training behind 
her friends' backs.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her Trainer scolded her, saying, "You 
idiot."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her Trainer scolded her, saying, "You 
fool."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Because she was a fool who knew nothing of 
common sense, no matter how insurmountable 
a wall was said to be, she continued to 
challenge it without ever realizing its 
difficulty.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And that display was... cooler than 
anything else. It gave her courage. Pushed 
forward by her Trainer's feelings and the 
friend who looks up to her, she begins 
walking forward once more.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
—It's fine to be an idiot, so aim to be 
the "Ultimate Idiot." With a new goal in 
mind, Tosen Jordan challenges Gold Ship at 
the Osaka Hai.
